text:
Maria (Growth): Quick sync: finalizing send plan for Welcome Jetstream cohort — want to ship Wed 9am PT. Key asks: segmentation, subject lines, preview text, tracking, and suppression.
Aj (Email): Wed 9am PT works. Proposed cohorts: A) New signups last 7d B) Invited but not activated C) Trial reactivations. Size estimates: A 4.2k, B 1.1k, C 800.
Dylan (Product Marketing): Agree. For A we push product-first messaging + benchmark CTA; B gets feature highlight + webinar invite; C gets benchmark recap + limited offer.
Rene (Design): I have 2 hero options. Will upload variants to Figma by EOD. Need decision on header image for cohort B (webinar).
Samira (Data Ops): Segmentation SQL ready. Quick note: exclude anyone who opened Welcome 2.0 in last 30d and global unsubscribes. Also needs suppression for APAC blackout list.
Aj (Email): Subject lines — A1: "Welcome to Redwood — your first steps" A2: "See how to cut inference cost by 3x" Preview: "Quick wins and setup guide"
Dylan (Product Marketing): For B (webinar): "Join our benchmarks deep dive — Wed 9/14" vs "Benchmarks that surprised us — live demo". Prefer second? feels more curiosity-driven.
Maria (Growth): Leaning into curiosity. Also want a small experiment: test personalization token in subject (first name) vs no name. 50/50 split within each cohort.
Aj (Email): Good. We'll run subject A/B within each cohort, and preview text A/B as a second layer. Track opens -> clicks -> webinar signups -> activation.
engbot: Automation: queued send configured. Reminder: kpis tag 'welcome_jetstream_v1' and UTM params should be utm_campaign=welcome_jetstream_v1&utm_source=email&utm_medium=campaign
Rene (Design): Uploaded Figma links: https://figma.com/file/xyz — header options 1/2. Also small GIF for A variant to show latency chart.
Samira (Data Ops): Adding tracking pixel config. Also setting up time-zone send windows (local send): US/EUR/APAC. For APAC we'll stagger to Thu 8am JST to avoid Wed blackout.
Aj (Email): Liquid snippets for personalization:
```
{{ user.first_name | default: "friend" }}, see how Redwood speeds up inference
```
Make sure fallback present.
Dylan (Product Marketing): CTA hierarchy: Primary: Benchmark report (link), Secondary: Sign up for webinar, Tertiary: Docs. Avoid burying benchmark inside footer.
Maria (Growth): Final checklist: creative locked by 12pm PT Tue; Segments frozen by 2pm PT Tue; QA send tests and seed list by 4pm PT Tue; final approvals in this thread.
Rene (Design): I'll tag where alt text and button styles live. Also will provide dark mode tweaks.
Samira (Data Ops): QA notes: include seed list with corporate emails + mobile clients. I'll run CAN-SPAM header checks.
Aj (Email): Sending test to #email-qa group at 3pm PT Tue. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you review.
Dylan (Product Marketing): Draft hero copy: "Infer faster, ship smarter — Redwood inference benchmarks". Will iterate on tone after design lock.
Maria (Growth): Great progress. If no objections, we'll proceed to schedule. Ping me if you need additional tracking props or promo codes.
Aj (Email): Scheduling sends now. Will post final send report after batch completes. :rocket:
Maria (Growth): :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — tagging final approvers @Dylan (Product Marketing) @Rene (Design) @Samira (Data Ops)
